title: Emoush the Destroyer
summary: Knock out all three mystics together to expose Emoush.
overview: Knock out all three mystics together to expose Emoush.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Coordinate the mystic kills so their unconscious periods overlap.
Damage Emoush while all three mystics are down.
The mystics revive after three minutes and can restore his protection while increasing his power.
Keep healing available for recurring Rumbling Stone casts.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 4.
